name: btn Add Fields
purpose: Generator button: builds a SQL ADD COLUMN statement for the selected field map item (varchar) and runs it with design_x_sql on the map's file, waits a second and refreshes the fields. Effect owner it would have: client-ui (developer tool).
writes: schema change: adds a column to FieldMap::table in file FieldMap::file (design_x_sql, step 3)
calls: karbon_Generator.fmp12/scripts/62 "btn: Refresh Fields For Selected Table" (step 8; Perform Script)
external: design_x_sql (step 3; custom function that runs a design SQL statement on another file)
open_question: Changes the schema of another FileMaker file at run time. Part of the Generator developer tool.

name: btn: Continue New Map From Filter
purpose: Generator button: takes the JSON path result and starts Create Map (JSON) with it.
open_question: Part of the Generator developer tool.

name: btn: Field Map Set Fields
purpose: Generator button: puts the generated Set Field script-step XML of the current field map on the clipboard (legacy or native format by RESOURCES::UseLegacy).
external: clip_Set (step 10; custom function that writes script-step XML to the clipboard)
open_question: Part of the Generator developer tool.

name: btn: Field Map GET Fields
purpose: Generator button: puts the generated field-read script-step XML of the current field map on the clipboard (legacy or native).
external: clip_Set (step 9; custom function that writes script-step XML to the clipboard)
open_question: Part of the Generator developer tool.

name: btn: New Map
purpose: Generator button: creates a new field map record, reads the clipboard, and if it holds JSON stores a pretty-printed copy in the map's JSON document and runs Make the Map; otherwise puts the cursor in the JSON field.
writes:
FieldMap (new record, New Record/Request step 2)
FieldMap::JSONDocument#5 (Set Field step 10, current record)
external: <Function Missing> (steps 4, 6, 9; plugin function reading the clipboard)
open_question: The clipboard function is shown as <Function Missing> (plugin). Part of the Generator developer tool.

name: btn: Make Map From Nested Array
purpose: Generator button: sets the globals for a map made from a nested array (source id read by name from the current layout's table, parent request, source table, back-navigation info, map name) and starts Create Map (JSON) with the item's value.
reads:
FieldMapItems::value#5 (step 2)
FieldMap::idSource#12 (step 4)
FieldMap::label#2, FieldMapItems::path#3 (step 8)
by name: GetField ( Get(LayoutTableName) & "::id" ) (step 3)
writes:
GLOBALS::Maps_SourceID#7 (Set Field step 3, global)
GLOBALS::Maps_SourceParentRequestID#13 (Set Field step 4, global)
GLOBALS::Maps_Source#8 (Set Field step 5, global)
GLOBALS::Back_Layout#11 (Set Field step 6, global)
GLOBALS::Back_Object#12 (Set Field step 7, global)
GLOBALS::Maps_Name#9 (Set Field step 8, global)
open_question: Part of the Generator developer tool.

name: btn: Delete Map
purpose: Generator button: asks for confirmation and deletes the current field map record when the user chooses Delete.
writes: delete: FieldMap (Delete Record/Request step 5, current record)
open_question: The dialog button 1 is Cancel (default) and button 2 is Delete; deletion runs on LastMessageChoice = 2. Part of the Generator developer tool.
